# Model card: Time between active days and time to silence

- Version `0.1.0+c4418043.20261018164433`, trained 2026-10-18, effort full.
- Data: synthetic data from the public generator (the numbers say nothing about any bank); fingerprint `c4418043910d`.
- MLflow run: kept in the local workspace's store, not published.

Intended use: Triage and prioritisation by people who review each case: a ranking of clients to look at first, never an automatic decision about a client.

## What it describes

How long clients go between active days (recurrent gaps, the last one censored at the end of the window), by channel profile, and a Cox model of the gap with standard errors clustered by client. Medians carry client-bootstrap intervals.

| Channel profile | Clients | Median gap in days (95% CI) | Waiting after 30 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| branch_only | 147 | 39.0 (32.0 to 47.0) | 58.8% |
| digital_only | 286 | 3.0 (2.0 to 3.0) | 3.2% |
| mixed | 513 | 3.0 (3.0 to 3.0) | 2.9% |

Log-rank test across profiles: p = 0.0000.

Cox hazard ratios:

| Covariate | Hazard ratio (95% CI) | Proportional hazards test p |
|---|---|---|
| age_decades | 1.00 (0.99 to 1.02) | 0.2990 |
| log_events | 2.25 (2.17 to 2.33) | 0.0000 |
| profile_digital_only | 1.36 (1.28 to 1.46) | 0.3453 |
| profile_mixed | 1.39 (1.29 to 1.50) | 0.7150 |

Concordance of the Cox model: 0.748.

## Training data

The public card describes a model trained on the synthetic generator's extract, read through the synthetic mapping into the same marts as the reference instance. On the machine that holds the extract the same code trains on the real marts in the private zone; that model, its card and its scores stay under `STRATA_PRIVATE_DIR`, and its metrics are not published.

## Ethical considerations

Hazard ratios describe the gaps between active days in the reference sample; they are associations, not effects of a channel or of age, and must not justify treating groups differently.

## Limitations

- One year of data: the outcome windows of consecutive cutoffs overlap, so a backtest's training labels share calendar weeks with its test labels, and seasonal effects cannot be told apart from trend.
- Code meanings marked `assumed` in the seeds (see `docs/data_card.md`) are used as stated.
- Synthetic results show that the pipeline works; they are not evidence about clients.

## Reproduce and refresh

`just dbt`, then `uv run strata train survival` (`--quick` for the effort of tests and demos; `uv run strata --private train survival` on the machine that holds the extract). The daily DAG retrains it, and its evaluation gate (`strata evaluate`) stops the run before the ledger if the model was trained on other data or ranks no better than chance.
